key_insight: Training with bounded trajectory residuals improves a lightweight selector that chooses unmodified candidate trajectories at inference.
engineering_relevance: The approach adapts trajectory selection while keeping the world model and candidate bank fixed, deploying only an 11,725-parameter ranking network.
method: Use PPO to jointly learn candidate selection and bounded residual exploration.
Train context-conditioned candidate preferences from feedback on locally perturbed trajectories.
At inference, combine learned preference and predicted risk ranks with fixed weights; discard the residual branch and critic.
evidence_signal: On open-loop nuScenes validation, L2 trajectory error decreased 3.99% versus RiskWorld without RL selection and 0.83% versus residual-free categorical PPO under matched feedback and actor-update budgets.
watch_item: Open-loop trajectory-error gains do not establish closed-loop driving safety or robustness.
paper_title: Residual-Guided Lightweight Reinforcement Learning for Risk-Aware Trajectory Selection with a Frozen World Model
